run.name: Caesars Entertainment, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CZR)
run.summary: Caesars is liquid but lease-burdened: debt-only leverage of 3.26x looks moderate, while cash interest cover including lease rent is 1.69x. The pending acquisition leaves the future of the existing debt open. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (company non-GAAP), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 11,659 and net debt 10,795 at September 30, 2026 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 3,573 (calculated). Excludes financing obligations; including the 13,188 of financing obligations, total debt plus obligations over EBITDA is 6.95x. Net debt deducts unrestricted cash only.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 3,573 over LTM cash interest 741 on debt plus 1,371 rent (calculated). Debt-only cover is 4.82x. Rent includes the small other financing obligations line from 2026 interims. Not a covenant ratio.

cash.basis: Cash. Unrestricted cash excluding restricted cash 94. Company basis: CEI 2,250 undrawn plus CVA 25, less 96 letters of credit, 40 reserves and 56 regulatory (company total 2,947 with cash). Net of letters of credit only: 2,179. CEI revolver matures January 31, 2028.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Merger financing, covenant ratio values and the debt documents are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a company non-GAAP measure and covenant ratio values are not printed.
